briefing.description: You're inbound to Centerville from the practice area. Pick up the ATIS before you call, make your initial call to Tower with position, ATIS, and intentions, then fly the pattern entry they give you — reading back every instruction with your callsign.
briefing.atisText: Centerville Regional information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Few clouds at five thousand. Altimeter {altimeter}. Landing and departing runway {rwy}. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.

steps.speaker: ATIS
steps.text: Centerville Regional information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Few clouds at five thousand. Altimeter {altimeter}. Landing and departing runway {rwy}. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.
ATIS copied. You're 10 miles {direction} of the field. You switch to Tower, 118.3.

steps.prompt: Make your initial call to Tower: who you are, where you are, ATIS, and what you want (full stop).
steps.hint: Centerville Tower, Skyhawk {callsign}, one zero miles {direction} with information {atis}, inbound full stop.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your full callsign on initial contact.

elements.label: distance and direction
elements.feedbackMissing: Give your position: “one zero miles {direction}”. Tower can't sequence you without it.

elements.label: the ATIS code
elements.feedbackWrong: You said information {heard}, but the current ATIS is {atis}.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, Centerville Tower, enter left downwind runway {rwy}, report midfield.

steps.prompt: Read back the pattern entry and the report point.
steps.hint: Enter left downwind runway {rwy}, will report midfield, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: pattern entry readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the entry instruction: “enter left downwind runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You forgot to read back the runway assignment.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but Tower assigned runway {rwy}.

elements.label: the report point
elements.feedbackMissing: Acknowledge the report point: “will report midfield”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.text: You join the left downwind for runway {rwy}. You're now midfield — time to report.

elements.label: midfield report
elements.feedbackMissing: Report the position Tower asked for: “midfield left downwind”.

elements.label: landing clearance readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the clearance: “cleared to land”. “Roger” doesn't confirm you heard it correctly.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You forgot to read back the runway with your landing clearance.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but you're cleared to land runway {rwy}.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.text: You land on runway {rwy} and roll out. Tower calls as you slow.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, turn left when able, taxi to the ramp, remain this frequency.

steps.hint: Left when able, taxi to the ramp, remain this frequency, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: taxi instruction readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the instruction: “taxi to the ramp”.

elements.label: remain this frequency
elements.feedbackMissing: Acknowledge “remain this frequency” — it tells Tower you won't switch to Ground.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.
